note: Adapted from the species-level description in Roonwal & Chhotani 1989, Fauna of India: Isoptera; the original is in English. The original covers four castes, Imago, Soldier major, Soldier minor and Worker, the two soldier forms being combined in the "Soldier" section. OCR problems: corruptions such as 'Anteonae' (antennae), 'sparsely pilosei', 'islightly emarginate' and 'saoule shaped' have been read correctly from context; the first two sentences of the worker description occur twice in the original and are not repeated here. To check: figure captions 283—285 in this entry give the name Schedorhinotermes translucens, which does not agree with the entry title brevialatus; the captions are probably carried over from the old text.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Soldiers of two forms, major and minor: major soldier body length about 6.0 mm, head length 1.59—1.88 mm, mandibles falcate, 0.90—1.10 mm long; minor soldier body length about 4.0 mm, head length (to base of mandibles) 0.74—1.07 mm, mandibles slender, 0.54—0.73 mm long. Alate body length with wings 12.0—14.5 mm, head width (including compound eyes) 1.67—1.90 mm, antennae 20-segmented. Worker body length 4.5—5.0 mm, head width 1.34—1.46 mm. Tibial spur formula 3:2:2 and tarsus 4-segmented in all castes.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head capsule pale reddish brown; pronotum paler than the head, abdomen darker; labrum and legs brownish yellow; antennae light brownish yellow; postclypeus brownish yellow with a brown median line. Head with a few scattered bristles; anterior margin of the postclypeus with several hairs; labrum near the apex and the body with several hairs; margin of the pronotum with long bristles and the body with a few. Body length with wings 12.0—14.5 mm, without wings 8.0—9.0 mm. Head capsule almost circular; sides (outside the compound eyes) almost straight; wider than long (width including compound eyes 1.67—1.90 mm, head length (to base of mandibles) 1.42 mm); posterior margin rounded. Frontal gland pore small, circular, median. Compound eyes almost oval, large and prominent (maximum diameter of the compound eye 0.54 mm, short diameter 0.46 mm). Ocelli oval (long diameter 0.17 mm, short diameter, i.e. width, 0.12 mm); 0.05 mm from the compound eye, far less than their short diameter. Antennae 20-segmented; segment 3 far longer than segment 2. Postclypeus large, conical, broad at the base, rounded and prominent in the middle; anteclypeus concealed by the forward-projecting postclypeus. Mandibles as in the genus. Labrum domed, far wider than long. Pronotum flat, subrectangular, far wider than long (width 1.48—1.63 mm, length 0.80—0.90 mm); anterior margin almost straight, without an incision; posterior margin shallowly concave in the middle. Wings transparent, strongly reticulate; media close to the cubitus, giving off 4—5 branches from the middle. Cubitus with about 10 branches. Tibial spurs 3:2:2.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text:
Major soldier: head capsule, postmentum and pronotum yellow to reddish yellow; labrum and abdomen slightly paler, straw yellow; mandibles brown to reddish brown, paler at the base; legs yellowish brown. Head and body sparsely hairy. Body length about 6.0 mm. Head capsule subsquare, slightly longer than wide, head length 1.59—1.88 mm, head width 1.49—1.84 mm; widest in the posterior half. Frontal gland pore circular, situated anteriorly; a groove runs forward to the tip of the labrum. Postclypeus wider than long, with a median groove. Labrum slightly wider than long, widest below the middle; with several hairs on the disc, the anterior margin with a ring of hairs forming a labral brush. Mandibles falcate, 0.90—1.10 mm long. Left mandible with 2 marginal teeth at mid-length. Right mandible also with a distinct first marginal tooth and a weakly developed second marginal tooth. Antennae 16—17-segmented; segment 3 about one and a half times as long as segment 2; segment 4 shortest. Postmentum sparsely hairy, moderately clavate, longer than wide (length 1.00—1.21 mm); widest at the anterior third (maximum width 0.41—0.46 mm); the sides narrowing into a waist at the posterior third (minimum width at the waist 0.28—0.33 mm). Pronotum sparsely hairy, with long and short hairs on the margins and the disc; anterior part slightly raised and convex; far wider than long (width 0.95—1.13 mm, length 0.51—0.61 mm); sides converging posteriorly; posterior margin slightly concave. Tibial spurs 3:2:2; tarsus 4-segmented.
Minor soldier: head capsule, pronotum and abdomen brownish yellow; postclypeus slightly darker; antennae slightly paler than the head; mandibles brown; legs pale. Head with several long bristles and hairs; anterior margin of the labrum with a ring of fine hairs and several more behind it; pronotum and abdomen with a few bristles and short hairs. Body length about 4.0 mm. Head capsule subsquare, slightly longer than wide (head length (to base of mandibles) 0.74—1.07 mm, width 0.69—0.98 mm); widest just behind the antennae, from there the sides converging slightly to the convex posterior margin. Frontal gland pore circular, situated anteriorly; a groove runs forward to the tip of the labrum. Antennae 15—16-segmented, segment 3 shortest. Postclypeus wider than long, with a median groove; anteclypeus short, transparent. Mandibles slender (length 0.54—0.73 mm). Inner margin of the anterior quarter of the left mandible with 2 marginal teeth; right mandible with 1 marginal tooth very close to the apex. Labrum long, rectangular; extending beyond the tips of the mandibles; anterior margin bilobed, with a ring of hairs. Postmentum arcuate, widest and inflated at the anterior third (length 0.46—0.67 mm, maximum width 0.28—0.33 mm), narrowing from there to a short anterior margin, and posteriorly to a broad waist (waist width 0.21—0.26 mm), then widening again to the concave posterior margin. Pronotum wider than long (width 0.46—0.60 mm, length 0.30—0.46 mm); anterior margin convex, projecting slightly forward; posterior margin weakly concave in the middle. Tibial spurs 3:2:2, tarsus 4-segmented.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head pale yellow; body straw yellow. Head moderately hairy; abdominal tergites with two irregular rows of bristles. Body length 4.5—5.0 mm. Head almost square; head width 1.34—1.46 mm. Frontal gland pore and cephalic sutures indistinct. Postclypeus inflated, short. Antennae 16—17-segmented: with 16 segments, segment 3 as long as segment 2; with 17 segments, segment 3 shorter than segment 2. Pronotum weakly saddle-shaped (pronotum width 0.64—0.72 mm), anterior margin triangular, without an incision.
